MINI MINUTES: APPEARANCES:
Angela Dunning, Atty. for Defendant and opposing party: Buzzlogic, Inc.

TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED: PLAINTIFF GIGABLAST INC.'s Motion To Compel Further Responses To Plaintiff's Special Interrogatories, Set Two, is granted. The court finds that the declaration in support of additional interrogatories was sufficient. A separate statement is not required where all of the responses are based upon the premise that the interrogatories exceed the limit of 35. Further responses shall be made within 15 days of notice of this order. All requests for sanctions are denied. COMMISSIONER EVERETT A. HEWLETT, JR. NOT REPORTED.
